# Full-only CI roots (read by tools/ci_targets.py).
#
# These generated per-weight certificate files are built by the `full` CI
# tier (weekly schedule, workflow_dispatch) but not on every master push:
# an edit to any of their ancestors rebuilds all ten (~70 min cold on a
# GitHub runner; Modal: 88–1227 s each).  Every default target that imports
# one of them (their Galois twins, HeckeGeneratedByT2Weights,
# HeckeRationalWeights, ...) is excluded from the push tier automatically.
# They are verified on Modal at every wave merge and audited by
# AxCheckDecide.  Add a root here only with a measured cold cost of several
# minutes; record the reason in the module's AGENTS.md layout entry.
